::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="No project values yet? Start with standard cases"}

- **[Mechanical ventilation](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-ventilation_system):** Standard cases include heat recovery; check winter and summer values.

- **[Mechanically ventilated uses](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-vent_modes):** If only non-residential areas are mechanically ventilated, start with [Mechanische Lüftung in Nicht-Wohn-Nutzungen]{.excel-value} (mechanical ventilation in non-residential uses).

- **[Night cooling](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-vent_night_modes):** Single-sided and cross ventilation are available for housing. Check openings and usable areas.

Check the applied values for your project. [How to apply presets](presets.qmd).

:::
